name: Itadaki Djungarian Chokotto Adventure
original_name: いただきじゃんがりあん ちょこっとあどべんちゃ～
source:
Game was initially sent over the mail for owners of [url=/v3390]Itadaki Djungarian[/url] as an apology for the game being riddled with bugs.
Protagonist goes on a quest to collect uniforms from various restaurants by challenging both new and returning characters to a typing battle.
translation:
Game was initially sent over the mail for owners of [url=/v3390]Itadaki Djungarian[/url] as an apology for the game being riddled with bugs.
